LongDescription: Samyang Hot Chicken Cheese Noodles 700 gm is a bulk-sized instant noodle product that combines the fiery spiciness of Samyang's Hot Chicken flavor with the creamy richness of cheese, offering a unique and bold taste experience.rnThis product includes multiple packs of instant noodles, each infused with a spicy cheese seasoning, designed for those who enjoy intense flavors.rnrnIngredients:rnNoodles: Wheat flour, modified tapioca starch, palm oil, wheat gluten, salt, glycerin, soy oil, acidity regulators (E501(i), E500, E339(ii), E330), thickener (E412), purified water, emulsifier (E322), green tea flavor oil.rnSoup Base: Water, artificial cheese flavoring powder, soy sauce, white sugar, artificial chicken flavoring powder, soy oil, chili bell pepper powder, paprika powder, onion, garlic, modified potato starch.rnPowder: Mozzarella cheese powder, roasted sesame, roasted lavender. rnrnCooking Process:rnBoil Water: Bring approximately 600 ml of water to a boil.rnAdd Noodles: Place the noodles into the boiling water.rnCook: Let the noodles cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.rnDrain: Drain the water, leaving a small amount if you prefer a soupier consistency.rnAdd Soup Base: Add the soup base and stir well to combine.rnAdd Cheese Powder: Sprinkle the cheese powder over the noodles and mix thoroughly until the noodles are well-coated.rnServe: Once the noodles are well-coated with the spicy cheese sauce, remove from heat and serve hot. rnrnUse: Ideal for a quick and satisfying meal, these noodles can be enjoyed on their own or enhanced by adding fresh vegetables, proteins like chicken or tofu, or a squeeze of lime to balance the spiciness.rnrnBenefits:rnQuick Preparation: Ready in minutes, suitable for busy individuals.rnBold Flavor:
